description: NaAu(O₃I)₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.40 Å. Au is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four O atoms. All Au-O bond lengths are 2.01 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Au and one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.92 Å. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Au and one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.90 Å. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two I atoms. There is one shorter (1.82 Å) and one longer (2.37 Å) O-I bond length. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent I atoms. There is one shorter (1.80 Å) and one longer (2.53 Å) O-I bond length. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.79 Å. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.81 Å. There are two inequivalent I sites. In the first I site, I is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. In the second I site, I is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms.
